integrity_statement: Proof-based result; a finite checker is supplementary and cannot validate the infinite-dimensional theorem. The scientific assessment is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Polynomial symbols and integer power maps on fixed Hilbert Hardy/weighted Bergman spaces only; not a classification of ordinary nonnormal spectra or of arbitrary analytic symbols. Exact two-channel norm information overlaps prior slant Toeplitz results. A broader implicit formulation remains a bibliographic risk.
source_ids: published:Exact antipodal boundary formula for the essential norm of Bergman slant Toeplitz operators (2026)
title: Boundary-orbit aliasing and spectral bulk for polynomial power-map Volterra companions
